risks.title: Increased competition in banking services
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the main risk factors section with moderate to high intensity language, reflecting persistent competitive pressure in core markets. The Competition category weighs significantly in the overall business risk assessment.

risks.title: Enhanced banking regulation
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the document, strong language (major risks), upward trend in European regulatory requirements. Regulation is a key category with high weight in banking activities.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and IT failures
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited risk with high intensity language (could seriously harm). Upward trend in digital threats. The category is strategic for financial institutions.

risks.title: Dependence on green regulation
risks.score_rationale: Secondary position in the document, but specific mention of Green/Social Bonds. Cautious language, upward trend in green regulatory expectations. Moderate weight of the category.

risks.title: Operational risks related to digital transformation
risks.score_rationale: Implicit mention through IT dependencies and modernization. Moderate language, but trend toward technological investment. Category increasingly strategic.

risks.title: Pressure on insurance product profitability
risks.score_rationale: Risk linked to the integrated bank-insurance structure, mentioned in the context of margins. Clear language, stable trend, high weight in the business model.

risks.title: Risks related to geopolitical concentration
risks.score_rationale: Mention of core markets (Belgium, Central Europe), with implicit exposure to local economic or political shocks. Moderate language, stable trend.
